text_block_list.text:
Actually, I've run out of my favorite hand 
cream...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's not even a particularly popular item, 
but it's been out of stock since last week 
so I can't buy it.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I recommended the same cream to Pony-chan 
last week... I wonder if she managed to 
buy it?"
choice_data_list: Could it be... because I recommended it?

text_block_list.text:
"Believe it or not—the hand cream Fuji 
Kiseki regularly used became a huge hit 
among her Ponies, leaving her to deal with 
rough hands for quite some time 
afterward."
